title.narrative: Third Tranche of the BioCarbon Fund (BioCFT3)

description.narrative:
"The BioCarbon Fund (""BioCF"") is designed to support projects that sequester or conserve carbon in forestscomma agricultural and other ecosystems in Developing Countries and Economies in Transition (Countries in Eastern Europe as defined by the UNFCCC). The Fund will purchase Greenhouse Gas Emission Reductions from projects that are additional to a Baseline scenario andcomma to the extent possiblecomma produce environmental and social benefits for local populations.
Tranche Three will build on the success of the two previous Tranches (TF051055 & TF070730)comma and aims to use climate finance to catalyze large-scale regeneration of degraded lands and sustainable land management. It will focus on land areas that are deforested and degraded that can be rehabilitated by better agricultural practicescomma and/or through reforestationcomma and/or those areas that interface with REDD+ boundaries. Specificallycomma it will (1) integrate landscape carbon accounting to pilot a landscape and ecosystem approach; (2) scale-up from a project to jurisdictional level; (3) include additional payments for ecosystem and environmental services besides carbon; (4) improve access for poor rural communities to environmental markets and safeguards; and (5) support and implement innovative financial approaches that help close the early stage funding gap."
